name: Brightness Scroller
description:
Scroll up or down in the Top Bar to dim or brighten the screen (software overlay, works on any monitor). Supports configuring granularity (default step of 5%) and optionally requiring a modifier key (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Super) to be held while scrolling.

Derived from Volume Scroller (https://github.com/francislavoie/gnome-shell-volume-scroller).
